summary.text: Prince Feng Xian's Northern Plains grotto-heaven, used as his residence and guest hall when Northern Plains rank eights are invited to Qin Bai Sheng's auction.

claims.text: In Northern Plains, Fairy Li Shan and Qin Bai Sheng visit the guest hall, where rank eight Prince Feng Xian sits upright as they bow and request to leave. He praises their auction for preventing fights and massacres, and says he has many Immortal Gu that do not suit his path and need exchanging there. He cannot attend himself because he was mediating heaven and earth qi in his immortal aperture when forced out by Immortal Gu work, and now must manage that world; he will send a representative instead. Swordmaster You Lan, one of two rank six female attendant Gu Immortals, leads the guests along a long corridor through several doors, then out of the entrance back into Northern Plains and closes it. Once shut, the sky shows no strangeness and matches the surroundings.

Inside the grotto-heaven a guest hall receives visitors. A long corridor leads through several doors to the entrance; once that entrance closes, the sky outside shows no strangeness and matches the surroundings.

After the guests leave, Feng Jiu Ge appears in the entrance hall and agrees to take Prince Feng Xian’s place at the auction. Prince Feng Xian warns that Feng Jiu Ge became immortal in Central Continent, so his aperture’s heaven and earth qi differ from Northern Plains, and that discovery among furious Northern Plains Gu Immortals hunting the Imperial Court culprit would be disastrous. Feng Jiu Ge uses vaguely familiar face to become an exact copy of Swordmaster You Lan, including disguised dao marks and a Northern Plains aura. Feng Jiu Ge praises the prince for ascending in Northern Plains for Spirit Affinity House’s major task and staying hidden for hundreds of years; Prince Feng Xian is a spy sent by Spirit Affinity House.

Prince Feng Xian stays inside Feng Xian grotto-heaven, does not communicate with his Gong tribe wife, and remains with attendants You Lan and Le Yao. Gong tribe is unhappy, but as a rank eight he cannot be forced.

When Old Ancestor Xue Hu begins refining fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu, Prince Feng Xian hears the news in Feng Xian grotto-heaven and treats capturing Fang Yuan as the current task after Heavenly Court confirms Fang Yuan is in Northern Plains.
Later he sits in the grotto-heaven with flames around him, spits fireballs for a deduction that fails to find Fang Yuan, and refuses a Gong tribe visit that brings a Longevity Edict.
